label: Rotation
description: Time-bound rotation across functions or geographies for development.

label: Permanent Move
description: Permanent transfer to a new role or location.

label: Stretch Assignment
description: Stretch assignment alongside current role to build new capability.

label: Project Assignment
description: Time-bound project assignment with defined scope and exit criteria.

label: Secondment
description: External or cross-entity secondment retaining home role.

label: Promotion
description: Upward move to a higher career level.

label: Cross-Functional Move
description: Lateral move to a different function at the same level.
